content:
Long-session memory (Railroad)

Optional structured memory extracted over time and re-injected into prompts so follow-up turns stay coherent (user-facing: “remembers details within your session/product limits”).

What this is

Session memory (product nickname “Railroad”) stores structured facts the assistant extracts across turns so long chats stay coherent—within privacy and retention rules for your plan.

How to use it

  • You do not manage memory manually; it updates as you chat.
  • Ask the assistant to “forget” sensitive details if the product exposes that control in your build.
  • Start a New chat for a clean memory scope.

Notes and limits

Memory is not a full backup of pages; it is distilled text used to steer replies.
